body: Authoring filemark docs (full grammar = skills/filemark/SKILL.md; invoke /filemark skill). Highest-impact traps: (1) Block components (Callout/Tabs/Tab/Details/ADR/DocBlock) need a BLANK LINE after the opening tag and before the closing tag or markdown inside renders literally (CommonMark HTML-block type 6). (2) Never self-close unknown components — <TaskStats md/> eats every following sibling; always write <Tag></Tag>. (3) Opening tag + all attrs must fit on ONE line (CommonMark type 7). (4) In task-view filter= never use < or >; use `in (p0,p1)` — angle brackets break HTML attr parsing. (5) Prefer double quotes in attrs (single quotes get mangled by shadcn stacks). (6) Recurrence (every:) does NOT auto-generate bullets — filemark is a reader; next instance is written by hand. (7) Don't double-render tasks: GFM renders - [ ] AND <TaskList> reprints them — hoist views to top, one canonical source appendix at end. (8) MindMap: prefer ```mindmap fence over <MindMap> wrapper (blank-line edge case). Task line numbers are body-relative (frontmatter stripped first).
